prompt.title: Sort what you can change
prompt.text: Write down what's bothering you. For each one, decide how much of it is up to you, then find the first step you can take yourself.
prompt.glossText: The book calls what you can affect your Circle of Influence, and everything you worry about your Circle of Concern.
prompt.whyItMatters: Worry spends energy on things you can't touch. Sorting your concerns shows where your effort pays off. Every step you take there makes that area a little bigger.

list.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first thing that's been on your mind.

form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. My manager keeps changing the deadline.
form.controlLabel: How much is up to you
form.havePrompt: Finish this: things would be fine if only I had…
form.havePlaceholder: e.g. a manager who plans ahead.
form.bePrompt: Now finish this: I could be more…
form.bePlaceholder: e.g. clear about what a change costs, in writing, each time.
form.firstStepPrompt: What's the first small thing you can do, this week?
form.firstStepPlaceholder: e.g. Ask for a 10-minute chat about how deadlines get set.
form.firstStepRequired: Write a first step you can take yourself.
form.letGoPrompt: It's not yours to fix. What will you do with the energy instead?
form.letGoPlaceholder: e.g. Leave ten minutes earlier and use the wait to read.
form.letGoRequired: Write one line about letting it go.

controlHint.direct: It's about what you do. Change your habit or your approach.
controlHint.indirect: It depends on someone else. Work on how you ask, listen and set an example.
controlHint.none: Nobody can change it: the past, the weather, how others are. Choose how you'll live with it.

checklist.concern: Add something that's on your mind
checklist.control: Say how much of it is up to you
checklist.step: Write a first step, or a line on letting it go
checklist.taken: Take the step and mark it, or mark it Let go

guide.inShort: You'll list what's bothering you and sort each item: up to you, up to others too, or out of anyone's hands. For the first two, you'll pick a first step. For the third, you'll decide to let it go. About ten minutes.
howTo: Tap "Add concern" and write what's on your mind, in one line.
Pick how much of it is up to you. Read the short note under each option.
Optional: write what you wish you had, then what you could be instead.
If it's up to you or others: write the first small step, and a date.
If nobody can change it: write one line on how you'll let it go.
Tap "Make it a promise" to track the step in Your promises. Mark the step taken when you've done it.

guide.afterwards: Take the first step this week, then come back and mark it. Notice how you feel about the concern afterwards. When a new worry shows up, sort it here before you spend an evening on it.
